source_method.notice_collection: License, licence, copying, notice, copyright, unlicense and authors files, plus files under licenses/licences directories. Original bytes are preserved. README license claims are not substituted for license text.
source_method.cached_archive_verification: Every available cached registry archive matched its Cargo.lock SHA-256; copied crate notice bytes were compared with the corresponding locked archive member.
source_method.supplemental_review: Two locked registry archives were SHA-256 verified and read without extraction. Missing published license texts were supplemented from exact crate VCS commits; their repository provenance is separate from archive membership. Complete MIT text already in r-efi AUTHORS was reclassified. JSONschema root workspace inheritance and identical same-commit cached sibling text were verified.
